Sure thing! To see the seat‑vs‑overage split on your invoice:
1. Go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices**.
2. Open the invoice you need.
3. Click the arrow on each line item to expand it – the seat charge will show the number of seats and per‑seat rate, and any overage line will show the metered quantity beyond the plan’s allowance.
4. If you prefer a PDF, download it from the same page; the PDF contains the exact same itemised breakdown, which you can attach to your budget review.
Let me know if you need any more help!
